intersection.headline: Nike returns to Formula 1 as official apparel supplier from 2027, replacing Puma
intersection.summary: Nike has signed a long-term deal to be F1's official apparel and uniform supplier from 2027, replacing Puma. It will make co-branded staff uniforms and consumer collections, starting with a Las Vegas Grand Prix capsule on 20 November. Nike also becomes an apparel partner of the all-female F1 Academy.

intersection.headline: Shohei Ohtani extends New Balance deal for the rest of his playing career
intersection.summary: New Balance has agreed a contract extension that keeps the Dodgers star with the brand for the remainder of his career. It is also renaming its Boston sports research lab after him. The brand says the deal reflects its investment in baseball and the sport's growth in Japan.

intersection.headline: Adidas named Marketing Week's Brand of the Year 2026 for its bounce back
intersection.summary: Marketing Week has crowned Adidas its Brand of the Year for 2026, citing the sportswear giant's standout recovery. It is a recognition of the brand's marketing turnaround. The link goes to Marketing Week's news page because I could not retrieve the individual article URL.

sports.headline: Infantino to face two challengers in the 2027 FIFA presidential election
sports.summary: FIFA says President Gianni Infantino will be challenged by France's Philippe Diallo and Japan's Kohzo Tashima, who have both been nominated. This makes the 2027 vote a contested race for the head of world football.

fashion.headline: Liberty and Barbour team up to reimagine classic prints on outerwear
fashion.summary: Two heritage British names are combining Liberty's archive prints with Barbour's outerwear. It is a collaboration between established brands rather than a routine product drop. The source gives only a short picture-led item, so details are limited.

marketing.headline: Southgate and Joe Cole tell brands not to 'dumb down' for sports fans
marketing.summary: Campaign reports on advice from Gareth Southgate and Joe Cole to marketers about how they speak to sports audiences. The names carry cultural weight, and the piece reports their views directly. The link goes to Campaign's media section page because I could not retrieve the individual article URL.

marketing.headline: M&S overtakes John Lewis as consumers' favourite Christmas ad, data finds
marketing.summary: Exclusive data shared with Marketing Week shows M&S has taken the lead as people's favourite Christmas ad so far. John Lewis, Aldi, Sainsbury's and Tesco follow, and Aldi still leads on branded recognition.

marketing.headline: At the NWSL championship, sponsors are putting athletes first
marketing.summary: Marketing Brew looks at how brands activated around this year's NWSL championship, with the players at the centre of the work. This is part of the continuing commercial growth of women's football. The link goes to Marketing Brew's homepage because I could not retrieve the individual article URL.

marketing.headline: Whoop becomes latest brand to combine a central F1 deal with a team-level agreement
marketing.summary: Whoop's biometric technology will feature in F1 broadcasts from 2027. It joins a growing group of brands that are merging a series-wide F1 sponsorship with an existing team deal. The link goes to SportBusiness's news page because I could not retrieve the individual article URL.
